about: Hazard-scoring evaluation set. Each case is a product with evidence excerpts and the band each named dimension SHOULD fall in: none (no evidence bears on it), low (0-29), medium (30-59), high (60+). Dimensions not named are not graded. Cases are invented; the wording follows real recall notices and reviews.
